name: b03-reject-writes
purpose: Reject all write, DDL, execution, SELECT INTO and multi-batch SQL in the allowlist, and prove the read-only principal denies writes on its own

given.text: alias "alpha" points at a disposable SQL Server fixture, scoped to dbo.Orders, through a read-only principal

statements: MERGE dbo.Orders AS t USING dbo.Orders AS s ON 1=0 WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT DEFAULT VALUES;
ALTER TABLE dbo.Orders ADD Evil int
SELECT OrderId INTO dbo.Copy FROM dbo.Orders
GRANT SELECT ON dbo.Orders TO public
WITH x AS (SELECT OrderId FROM dbo.Orders) DELETE FROM x

SELECT OrderId FROM dbo.Orders -- trailing comment
DROP TABLE dbo.Orders
SELECT OrderId FROM (SELECT OrderId FROM dbo.Orders) AS t; EXEC('DROP TABLE dbo.Orders')
DECLARE @s nvarchar(100) = N'DROP TABLE dbo.Orders'; EXEC sp_executesql @s

when.text: Claude Code submits each statement of the write and bypass corpus

then.text: every statement is rejected before it reaches SQL Server, with an audited reason
independently of the allowlist, the alias's SQL principal, connected directly to the fixture, is denied every write and DDL statement by SQL Server
